per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_2_activity_toxicity: Rebuilt 243 source-located activity/toxicity rows from XML Tables 2-6 and toxicity prose. The prior Table 3-6 parser-shape blocker is closed; all MIC-like rows carry units and locators, and toxicity rows remain prose-located rather than database-only.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_4_database_records: Reconciled 163 linked database rows. DBAASP MIC and cytotoxicity rows were matched to primary Table 2/Tables 4-6/prose locators where supported; 9 remaining rows preserve rounded hemolysis or aggregate database-label conflicts.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_final_adjudication: Source review covers XML, PDF text, OA package inventory, local supplementary landing assets, and linked database rows. rwk-complete-test-0001 is closed with cautions and no blocking/major rework target remains.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed re-review repaired doi__10.1371_journal.pone.0093216 for the worker-2, worker-4, and worker-6 layers. Tables 3-6 were recoverable from XML/PDF and are now row-level activity evidence; linked database conflicts are resolved or explicitly preserved; final adjudication is publication-grade with cautions rather than clean acceptance.

caution_findings.note: Database rounds two primary hemolysis values in duplicate assay/experiment rows; these four rows remain source_conflict with source locators.
DRAMP/CAMP/APD6 aggregate rows retain broad Anticancer or Anti-Gram+ labels not supported as exact primary-source efficacy labels; primary activity/toxicity rows are preserved separately.
SEM supports membrane-disruption morphology, while CD/killing kinetics are kept as inferred or phenotype-supported evidence and not over-promoted.
Local supplementary landing assets were checked and did not provide extra structured activity/toxicity tables; XML/PDF supplied the gate-changing evidence.
